exposure: Primigravida women undergoing primary caesarean section
Multigravida women undergoing primary caesarean section
outcome: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) incidence in babies
cohort: The study included 150 primigravida and 150 multigravida women who underwent primary caesarean section at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Fetal distress was the most common indication for primary caesarean section in both groups, with multigravida women having higher rates of blood transfusion, iron sucrose infusions, angle extension, and surgical site infections, while primigravida women had more postoperative ileus and their babies experienced more birth asphyxia, and babies of multigravida women had more RDS.
